title: DBProxy.Delay sleeps once per read chunk, not once per round trip
notes: A result larger than one 32K read is delayed several times, so the schedules' 'up to 300 ms' is approximate. Closed at the pivot: Rule 17: says nothing a viewer or operator would notice (a test's strength, a refactor, tooling or an internal cost). Reopen with the effect someone sees and its evidence.
